mapper.insert: INSERT INTO catalog_revision(tenant_id,sku_id,revision,store_id,title,unit_price,status,reason,actor_id) SELECT tenant_id,sku_id,revision,store_id,title,unit_price,status,#{reason},#{actor} FROM catalog_sku WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND sku_id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM catalog_sku WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND store_id=#{store} AND status='ACTIVE' AND sku_id > #{after} ORDER BY sku_id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM catalog_sku WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND store_id=#{store} AND status='ACTIVE' AND sku_id IN #{id} ORDER BY sku_id

SELECT s.sku_id,s.store_id,s.title,CAST(COALESCE(p.unit_price,s.unit_price) AS CHAR) unit_price,s.revision,COALESCE(p.version,0) channel_price_version,p.valid_to FROM catalog_sku s LEFT JOIN catalog_channel_price p ON p.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND p.store_id=s.store_id AND p.sku_id=s.sku_id AND p.channel=#{channel} AND p.active=TRUE AND p.valid_from<=#{now} AND p.valid_to>#{now} WHERE s.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND s.store_id=#{store} AND s.status='ACTIVE' AND s.sku_id IN #{id} ORDER BY s.sku_id
